nodes.label: Six-Step Projection Wizard
nodes.rationale: The 6-step guided wizard: Add & rest -> Position & turn -> Label vertices -> Draw top & front views -> Add side view -> Flatten to 2D, each step revealing its own action button and completion badge, with a pinned Back/Next/Reset footer.

nodes.label: Solid & Placement Controls
nodes.rationale: The dock control groups: shape select (cube/pyramids/prisms/curved), base-length and height sliders, resting-plane select (HP axis-upright vs VP axis-horizontal), distance-from-HP/VP sliders with a VP-distance-measured-to select, and a turn-about-axis slider plus Orient-to-corner toggle enforcing the simple-positions no-tilt pose model.

nodes.label: Orthographic Projection Viewport
nodes.rationale: #sim-viewport with the top-left cluster of Top/Front/Side quick-view camera chips and a connector-line declutter toggle, plus an empty-start overlay, orbit hint, spotlight, and the fade-in first-angle badge.

nodes.label: Simple Positions Problem Library
nodes.rationale: A full-viewport problem-library dialog and an active-problem header (statement, self-check, exit), the same textbook-practice component pattern as the Points topic.
